top_signals.title: Kremlin Pushes to Keep Russia’s Edge as Biggest Wheat Exporter
top_signals.summary: The Kremlin is pushing wheat exporters and growers to maintain Russia’s geopolitical advantage as the top shipper of the grain, despite disruptions to ports in the Black Sea region.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Goldman, GIC Among Buyers in NSE’s $703 Million Anchor Book
top_signals.summary: Goldman Sachs, HSBC, Fidelity and Eastspring are among major investors that participated in the anchor book of National Stock Exchange of India Ltd. before the world’s busiest derivatives exchange opened its initial public offering to the public, aiming to raise as much as 226 billion rupees ($2.4 billion).
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: More than 100 trucks, four drivers sidelined in recent enforcement actions
top_signals.summary:
Authorities in Canada and Missouri recently conducted targeted commercial vehicle operations resulting in more than 100 trucks being placed out of service.
